properties.description: 2026-09-11, after PR #474. The scorer half of criterion 1 (`req:every-served-tool-is-reachable-by-find-tools-on-a-users-words`): `term_weights` and `score_tool` match whole words rather than substrings, zero-weight a term present in every entry, and normalise for description length — measured over the 180-query corpus as 53 misses → 42 with no tool regressing. Must NOT include the vocabulary half (12 zero-overlap misses), which needs the user's register carried on each tool and awaits Anthony's ruling on option (b) of dec:idea-a-problem-in-the-users-words-should-retrieve-the-tool-that-answers-it. Sequence 415 follows epoch:reference-parameters-name-their-type (414).
properties.name: find_tools scores what a query means
